{{Infobox auto}}

'''Pumpkin curry''' is an oven meal of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 20 minutes, the longest Resistance from food. It is the only food that can only be cooked in an [[oven]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Pumpkin Curry Stock]] cooks into pumpkin curry in 15 seconds in an [[oven]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Resistance I for 20:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== Advancements ==
* ''Fortified Goodness'': make pumpkin curry (1 [[obol]]).
